description: A custom Unreal Engine plugin designed to integrate Epic Online Services (EOS) seamlessly, featuring session management, login handling, and full Blueprint support.

items.title: Key Features
items: Seamless EOS integration for login and authentication.
Session management including creation, finding, joining, and destruction.
Full async task system for optimized performance and Blueprint support.

description: The goal of YuniEOS is to simplify multiplayer game development in Unreal Engine by providing a robust EOS integration.
The plugin is designed to be modular, extensible, and fully usable in both C++ and Blueprints.
Built with a modular architecture, ensuring flexibility in expanding session features.
Utilizes BlueprintAsyncActionBase for clean and efficient asynchronous task execution.

elements.description: Handles authentication and auto-login for Epic Online Services.
Supports session creation, searching, joining, and destruction.

description: The plugin successfully handles EOS integration in Unreal Engine, offering an optimized workflow for multiplayer session management.
